results.title: pCloud: Cloud Storage
results.snippet:
pCloud is the secure place to store, preview and share files, anywhere you go. Start with up to 10 GB free storage.

You'll be able to backup photos and videos from your device, play your personal playlists, or preview work-related documents. You'll also be able to share large files with anyone and control access with password protection and expiration dates. From your vacation photos to videos and work documents, pCloud brings all your files together.

• Start with up to 10 GB free. Extend the space on your phone with up to 2 TB
• Choose where to store your files - in the United States or the European Union.
• Scan invoices, reports or receipts with an easy-to-use document scanner.
• Backup photos and videos from your phone with the option Automatic Upload.
• Access and preview files across all your devices.
• Share large files with added security (password protection, expiration date).
• Play your personal music collection with the built-in audio player.
• Get offline access to important files, when you're on the go.
• Encrypt private files with client-side encryption, using pCloud Encryption.

Use pCloud Encryption as the vault for your passwords, financial reports or other sensitive documents. The files you upload to the Crypto folder will be protected with client-side encryption. With pCloud's zero-knowledge privacy policy we, as a service provider, will not know what kind of data you store in the Crypto folder.

pCloud is also available for iOS, desktop (Windows, macOS and Linux) and from my.pCloud.com.

results.title: NordLocker: Private Cloud
results.snippet:
Secure cloud storage space that puts privacy first: Encrypt, sync, and share photos, videos or any files

NordLocker cloud storage offers file protection powered by end-to-end encryption, enabling you to upload, sync, and secure all of your digital material in seconds. Shielding your files from hackers and malware, this cloud storage solution provides sophisticated end-to-end encryption for solid data security. Secure multi-factor authentication ensures that your data and files are kept completely protected.

🔒 Encrypt files to boost your data security

Encryption is key to the NordLocker package. Secure cloud storage utilizes end-to-end encryption to ensure that files are protected from snooping or accidental exposure.

State-of-the-art encryption ensures that it is impossible to access any of your private data. Everything you encrypt and share with others can only be accessed by you and the people you trust.

NordLocker enables you to encrypt files before they leave your device for maximum security, only uploading to the cloud once this encryption is complete. This makes NordLocker the ideal cloud storage solution for users seeking for true ownership of their data.

🤫 Zero-knowledge architecture

The zero-knowledge encryption used by NordLocker enables data to be secured via a unique user key. This ensures complete confidentiality, as all data remains with the users at all times.

This also means that only owners of the private keys can ever access the stored data. Unlike the regular cloud storage providers that track everything you upload, NordLocker deals only with encrypted data, stored securely and privately.

🛡️ Multi-factor authentication secures account data

In order to further secure user data, NordLocker also protects your critical information with multi-factor authentication. Every user must confirm their identity via multi-factor authentication, meaning that your account is completely secure, even if your password is compromised.

The multi-factor authentication used by NordLocker encompasses passwords, external devices, and biometrics. NordLocker cloud storage allows users to protect their accounts with Google Authenticator, Authy, or Duo. All of this collectively makes breaching account security a practically impossible task.

👨‍💻 Multiple devices supported

NordLocker cloud storage also supports cloud syncing, enabling users to access files across multiple devices, at all times. Everything from desktop computers to smartphone is supported, providing users with a range of options. Cloud syncing keeps your files up-to-date and accessible wherever you are in the world, offering unrivaled convenience and flexibility.

📱 User-friendly interface

The NordLocker cloud app also makes it easy to manage your files via a user-friendly interface. Choose any files to upload and NordLocker does the rest, encrypting the files first, and then storing them on your secure cloud.

💪 One of the best protection available

NordLocker is the ideal cloud storage app to store and protect your most important documents and memories. Our encrypted cloud solution is user-friendly, flexible, and highly secure. Sign up today, and we'll offer you a 30-day money-back guarantee.

📦 Extra space storage

NordLocker gives you more storage space for your files. Store all of your files with free storage space to spare. Start with 3 GB of free cloud storage space or upgrade to a premium plan to get up to 500 GB or 2 TB of cloud storage space.

🗄️ Store any file

NordLocker offers secure space for all your documents and media. Easily encrypt and store any kind of files and access them via any device – anywhere and anytime.

Download NordLocker cloud storage now and boost your data privacy.

results.title: DeNet: Private Cloud Storage
results.snippet:
Private cloud storage for your photos, videos, files and folders.

Back up your important data, free up space on your devices, and keep your files under your control. Built for privacy and data sovereignty.

Private & encrypted

Your files are encrypted on your device before they leave it and can only be decrypted with your private key.
Your private key stays under your control. Neither DeNet nor Datakeepers can access or decrypt your files.

Decentralized

Your encrypted files are split into multiple parts and distributed across a decentralized network of independent storage providers called Datakeepers.
No single Datakeeper stores your complete file, creating a storage system without a single point of failure.

Automatic backup

Automatically back up photos, videos, files and folders from your devices.
Keep important data protected and free up space without deleting the files you want to keep.

One account across your devices

Use the same private key across mobile, Windows, macOS and Linux.
Access and synchronize your files across devices with one account.

Flexible storage, not a fixed subscription

You pay for the storage you actually use — not for a fixed subscription period.
Your storage balance is consumed based on the amount of data you store. If you don't store data, your balance isn't consumed.
Store more, and your balance is used faster. Store less, and it lasts longer.

Free to install. No ads.

DeNet is free to install and contains no third-party advertising.

Explore the DeNet ecosystem

The DeNet app gives you access to more than storage. You can also run a Watcher Node directly from the same app and participate in the ecosystem built on the DeNet Storage Protocol.
